agreement.high: The two data points agree, so the range is narrower.
agreement.close: The two data points are close but not identical.
agreement.low: The two data points disagree: the range contains both.

durability.steady: On long runs your heart rate stays steady (drift {drift}%): a point in your favor.
durability.rising: On long runs your heart rate climbs a lot (drift {drift}%): endurance still needs building.

causes.volume: low weekly volume ({km} km a week)
causes.longRun: a long run that is too short (longest {km} km)
causes.oldReference: a reference effort that is not recent
causes.sentence: {causes} {count, plural, one {keeps} other {keep}} the range wide{toward, select, yes { toward the cautious end} other {}}.

racePrediction.adequate: Volume and long run are adequate, so the range is narrow.

advice.tooFast: Your goal of {goal} is outside the range today (you would need better than {best}): start cautiously at {pace} and decide after halfway.
advice.tooSlow: Your goal of {goal} is slower even than the cautious estimate: it is within reach, start at {pace}.
advice.ambitious: Your goal of {goal} is inside the range but on the fast side: you need a good day. Start at {pace}, not at {goalPace}, and only speed up late if you feel good.
advice.inside: Your goal of {goal} is inside the range: start at {pace}.

sentence.range: average of the last 2 weeks {recent}, a month ago {previous}
sentence.stable: Stable: average of the last 2 weeks {value}, same as a month ago.
sentence.notEnough: You need a few more weeks of data to see a trend.

vo2max.label: VO₂max
vo2max.bad: often follows weeks with less running or more fatigue
vo2max.about: The watch's estimate of how much oxygen you can use at maximum effort (ml per kg per minute). The higher it is, the bigger the aerobic engine. It changes slowly: what counts is the trend over weeks.

fitness.label: Fitness (CTL)
fitness.bad: you are doing less than before
fitness.about: Average of your training load over the last 6 weeks. It rises when you train consistently and falls when you do less.

load7.label: 7-day load
load7.about: Sum of your load over the last 7 days, from the duration and intensity of your activities.

sleep.label: Sleep
sleep.about: Hours slept per night according to the watch. It is the first building block of recovery from training.

sleepDeep.label: Deep sleep
sleepDeep.about: Minutes of deep sleep: the phase when the body repairs muscles and tissues.

sleepScore.label: Sleep score
sleepScore.about: The watch's score for the night (0–100): it combines duration, stages and awakenings.

restingHr.label: Resting HR
restingHr.bad: may mean fatigue, stress or an illness coming on
restingHr.about: Beats per minute at rest, measured overnight. It drops as your heart gets trained; a few extra beats for several days is a sign of fatigue, stress or illness.

hrv.label: HRV
hrv.good: your nervous system is recovering well
hrv.about: Variation between one heartbeat and the next, measured overnight. The higher it is compared with your usual values, the better you are recovering. The trend matters, not a single number.

stress.label: Stress
stress.about: Average stress of the day (0–100), estimated by the watch from heart rate and variability.

spo2.label: SpO₂
spo2.about: Blood oxygen measured by the watch. Normally between 95 and 100%: it only matters if it drops a lot.

efficiency.label: Meters per beat
efficiency.good: you run faster at the same heart rate
efficiency.bad: at the same heart rate you run slower (heat and fatigue weigh in)
efficiency.about: How many meters you cover per heartbeat on easy runs: speed (meters per minute) divided by average HR. If it rises, you go faster at the same heart rate: your fitness is improving. Intervals, tests and threshold runs don't count; heat and hills lower it.

steps.label: Steps
steps.about: Steps for the day, running included.

pai.label: PAI
pai.about: Zepp score for your activity over the last 7 days, weighted by heart rate. 100 or more is the recommended level for health.

watchLoad.label: Watch load
watchLoad.about: Training load calculated by the Zepp watch over the last 7 days.
